issues.concern: The gloss is misleading by including 'leg (cut of meat)'. While 'もも' can refer to the thigh as a cut of meat, it does not mean 'leg' in general, even as a cut of meat. The 'leg' cut of meat is typically '脚 (ashi)' or 'レッグ (regu)'.
issues.suggestion: Change 'thigh; leg (cut of meat)' to 'thigh; thigh (cut of meat)' or simply 'thigh'.

issues.concern: The gloss 'thigh meat' is misleading. While 'もも' can refer to the thigh as a cut of meat, it doesn't mean 'thigh meat' as a standalone term. It's 'もも肉 (momoniku)' for 'thigh meat'.
issues.suggestion: Change 'thigh; upper leg; thigh meat' to 'thigh; upper leg; thigh (cut of meat)'.
